title: Luger briefly breaks Hogan’s reign
summary: Lex Luger becomes WCW’s immediate hope of removing Hogan as champion while Sting waits. A Nitro victory produces a rare company-wide celebration, followed by a rapid reversal.

chapters.title: Luger wins on Nitro
chapters.result: Luger submits Hogan to win the WCW World championship.
chapters.context: WCW’s wrestlers celebrate a major defeat for the nWo.

chapters.title: Hogan wins the belt back
chapters.result: Hogan defeats Luger to regain the championship.
chapters.context: The short reign ends within days, restoring the obstacle that WCW’s challengers must overcome.
